The affix यञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. कपिand 2. बोध when the special descendants of the family of अङ्गिरस are meant.

Terms: यञ्
After the word कापिशी , the affix ष्फक् is added in the remaining senses (the feminine being formed by ङीष् -- षिद्गौरादिभ्यश्च

The affix ढक् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after the words 1. कपि and 2. ज्ञाति।

Terms: ढक्
In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु and ending in the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च

, has acute accent (उदात्त) on the syllable preceding the affix.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The word कपिष्ठल is irregularly formed denoting the founder of a गोत्र (Patronymic) of that name.

Terms: ष change
